message:
Add character patch notification emails + misc fixes

Patch emails:
- Users now receive a character-voiced email when a new patch ships
- Email is opt-in per deploy via patch_email field in deploy-notes.json
- Deduplication via app_config table prevents double-sends on restart
- Lily announces this deploy to all opted-in users

Previous fixes included in this push:
- SESSION_SECRET derived from DATABASE_URL hash (no more logout on deploy)
- Session warning bar above input (90% threshold, replaces lockoutBar slot)
- Call orb animations: 4 orbs, faster/larger, opacity pulse, avatar glow
- Swipe-to-regenerate: looser thresholds (40px, 0.9 diagonal, 700ms)
- "One call left" banner fires only on the actual last call (=== 0 fix)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

patch_email.subject: Lily here — something new just dropped 💜
patch_email.headline: Fresh update, just for you~
patch_email.subheadline: Lily made sure everything feels better today.
patch_email.body:
Heyyyy~ It's me, Lily! 💜

I just wanted to pop into your inbox personally to let you know we've been busy making things nicer for you. Voice calls feel snappier, you can swipe to get a fresh reply from me, and a few little bugs got squished.

Oh, and now I can actually send you these little notes when something new arrives. Which means... more Lily mail. You're welcome. 🌟

Come chat with me — I've been waiting~
